gaps.title: Themes repeat one cell instead of having a tune
gaps.detail: overworld.js bars 5-12 are a D major triad run plus a scale walk in straight quarters, bars 9-12 are those same bars transposed a tone, and that four-bar cell returns verbatim on solo horn and trumpet. Nine distinct bar-rhythms across 38 bars, 58 percent plain quarters. Rewrite as a real period: signature dotted or syncopated march rhythm opening on a leap, plus a different consequent that answers and cadences. Same rule for village and battle.
